title: Hollow Decree Seer
text: Hollow Decree Seer projects a dead ruler's command into the lane and makes machinery obey the empty authority. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The throne is vacant. The order is not.

defeatReward.text: Hollow Decree Seer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
